scope.notes: Regression-only review as the README instructed; items left empty because F-0003 and F-0004 were verified by the re-run. diff.json reports 0 introduced findings and 0 introduced instances in the 12 persisting tool findings. Lint did not run this round (4 findings cleared_not_rechecked), so source-level regressions were not checked. The ARIA tree (probes/1/aria.yml) shows the Sensors status cells now carry text names (OK, Warning, Alarm); no names, roles or landmarks were lost. Forced-colours and more-contrast captures show the status text and no visible breakage elsewhere. The changes are confined to the Sensors table and to the colour of the 'Last reading' and metric labels; nothing else changed in the pixels. No tell swap seen. Both regressions are low severity.
